author: H.D. (Hilda Doolittle)
title: Sea Garden
edition: London: Constable and Company Ltd., 1916, as shown on the title page transcribed in Project Gutenberg ebook 28665. PG transcription of the Constable text; the transcriber lists a small number of typographical corrections. Paragraph and stanza boundaries and line breaks are retained; prose layout whitespace is joined. Page numbers, running heads, and footnote callout numerals are omitted. The library text holds the twenty-seven poems from “Sea Rose” through the closing untitled poem (“The city is peopled”); the acknowledgements note, title page, contents and printer's colophon are omitted.

rights.basis: Published in 1916, before 1931; the US copyright term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg identifies ebook 28665 as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (pglaf mirror of ebook 28665). Removed the Gutenberg header, footer, licence, producer credit and both transcriber's-note boxes, and everything before “Sea Rose” and after the last poem (illustration marker and colophon); every poem title became a level-2 heading and every section numeral a level-3 heading; every other block is a stanza with the file's common left indent removed and its line breaks kept. The transcriber's corrections listed in the file stand as transcribed; underscore italics kept as in the file.
